description: Lists this app's recent release runs, newest first: each release Ploa carried (started from the CLI, an agent or the dashboard) with its state, who started it, when, how long it took to reach TestFlight or internal testing, the commit, and every step with its duration (build, upload, App Store Connect or signing, Apple processing or Google Play, the testing track, and the App Review or promotion step a person approves). Use it to see why a release failed or where it is.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_runs
title: Release runs, step by step
